events.title: Demo Update: 12 Languages, Saved Profiles & History
events.summary: The Windows Demo of Gaming DNA & ESTI has been updated. This update focuses on languages, player profiles and session history, making it easier to return to practice, enter challenges and revisit your ESTI results. 12 interface languages English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish and Polish are supported. events.title: Demo Submitted for Review
events.summary: The Gaming DNA & ESTI demo was submitted to Steam for review on September 14. It brings together a range of skill tests and focused challenges to help you discover your strengths and beat your personal best. Thanks for following the project. Add the game to your wishlist and stay tuned for the demo launch. — Goblet Studio
